title: Interrupted chains preserve attempt elapsed time and unknown step measurements
steps: Interrupt an active planner snapshot during a retry, settle its brief, and read Ops after later unrelated brief updates.
expect: Interrupted elapsed time uses the current attempt and immutable settlement stamp while retaining the raw chain snapshot.
Legacy updated-at elapsed is explicitly an upper bound; missing or malformed time keeps the snapshot lower bound.
The original failure is exposed and unfinished step duration and spend remain null.
Startup and stale recovery stamp settlement without changing their existing state or retry decisions.
fence: Interrupted chain measurement projection and brief settlement timestamps

tests: an interrupted chain keeps elapsed attempt time and its actual error without inventing step measurements
an interrupted chain freezes settlement time after later unrelated brief updates
a legacy interrupted snapshot reports last-update elapsed as an upper bound
malformed interruption times cannot replace a measured lower bound or create negative elapsed time
an interrupted retry keeps its settlement elapsed time and original snapshot after later updates
a process that starts settles at once the open rows a dead process left
a worker that died as placing began, before any write was kept, does not claim the site is untouched
